correctness.rationale: For irrational σ>1 from the grid origin, the qth vertical crossing has event index floor(q/α)−1, α=1/(1+σ), giving characteristic mechanical bits b_j=1+2(floor((j+2)α)−floor((j+1)α)). The phase of this Sturmian coding is α rather than arbitrary. Each characteristic length-m prefix has both left predecessors by perturbing the coding phase just below and above α; density of forward irrational rotation makes both extended patterns occur. Reflection of the rotation partition gives reversal symmetry and Sturmian complexity m+1 guarantees exactly one right-special length-m binary factor, its reverse prefix. In the marked word X=0 2 b0 2 b1..., factors containing 0 occur once; factors ending in binary letter have forced successor 2; other branching factors must end in 2 and reduce in both parities to the base right-special word. n=1 gives factor 2. Therefore exact X_n...X_1 unique with two continuations 1,3 for all n≥1. Independent finite factor enumeration for σ=√2,√3,√5,√11 and n≤80 matched reverse prefix/continuations; analytic Sturmian proof establishes infinite quantifiers.
